what_this_run_supports: Under the frozen geometry rule (sha256 a7452748d40c511a14a1c7848ece5fe7f8f8901cc30f45a66918c89eb593a633) applied byte-identically to the three served bundles of gate_packet/38839347028 (de 214, fr 217, it 211 decisions), the relevance_ordered variant (V2) passes 22/33 criteria vs the accepted incumbent's 16/33, with zero criterion regressions on any bundle (de 7/11, fr 8/11, it 7/11 vs incumbent 6/5/5).

Removing un-hydrated shells (detail_status != 'search_hit') from the clusterable input is what moves COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG, COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM and STRUCTURE_LARGEST; the accepted ablation localised the cause and this run builds the input change it implied.

The component is a pure, deterministic, drop-in function behind the query_result_bundle seam emitting the shipped qmap shape (cluster_id, x, y, label, size, member_ids) with no rendering, UI, colour or interaction change; source-linking fields (source_url, canonical_url, citation, court, decision_date, docket_number) are preserved on every row.
what_this_run_does_not_support: That the map is USEFUL to a jurist. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and is not answered here.

That proximity now means query-conditioned similarity: PROJ_SPEARMAN and PROJ_KNN10 still fail on every bundle under both variants; STRUCTURE_SEP fails on every bundle and is measurably unreachable on de and it under any clustering (oracle-best ratio 0.914/0.919 vs 0.90 bar at the operative k=8).
That PROJ_RANK can be moved by any layout: it is coordinate-invariant under the frozen scorer (Spearman of TF-IDF cosine distance to the query vector vs retrieval rank).
That any decision supports, limits or contradicts the answer.
That the shipped map should be served unchanged: 0 of 3 bundles pass all 11 criteria under the promoted variant, exactly as under the incumbent.
That OUTLIER_VALIDITY is reachable on it: the citation graph is empty (total degree 0), so the frozen DEGENERATE->FAIL clause fires under any variant.
claim_ceiling.accepted_fail_is_preserved: The accepted frontier-map-semantics verdict (run 38846038296, accept commit 15362f6, 0 of 3 bundles passing, promoted decision 'FAIL with NO working in-budget alternative') remains the verdict of record for the SHIPPED geometry. This run does not retract it.
